title: English Practice Quiz 0856
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.

questions.question: The hospital is ___ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two things.
